programme.title: Voices for Humanity
programme.desc: Twin brothers Dan and Ari Agami realized early on the hardships and social ills caused by a lack of education; they introduced a revolutionary system of learning that's helping students succeed in their native Mexico and around the world.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Hossam Ramzy's signature exotic rhythms make him a go-to percussionist for Hollywood blockbusters and music's biggest stars.

programme.title: Signature Performances
programme.desc: Stanley Clarke, bassist and composer, brings together a band of consummate, young musicians for his latest album; the artist discusses his influences and inspirations while reflecting on his incredible musical journey.

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist
programme.desc: An American sculptor, a British salon owner and a South African piano technician are just some of the people from around the world who share how using the tools they learned in Scientology improves and enhances their everyday lives.

programme.title: The Problems of Work

programme.title: Destination Scientology

programme.title: Voices for Humanity
programme.desc: Manishwar Purmanund champions human rights across the island nation of Mauritius; tracing many of the country's social ills to the lack of human rights education, his work is empowering citizens and helping to build a more just and stable society.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Bright Chou and Annie Hsu are propelling Taiwan's pastry industry into exciting new frontiers with new ingredients and product innovations that number over 300 every year; but the sweetest part of their success is helping to uplift others.

programme.title: Destination Scientology
programme.desc: Kansas City, Mo., the land of jazz, cowboys and barbecues in the heartland of America, is a place where cultural pride runs deep; how the Church of Scientology helps bring its residents together to create a thriving community.

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist
programme.desc: A Hungarian business manager, an Italian ski instructor and an American horse rancher are some of the everyday people from across the globe sharing their stories on how they use Scientology to improve their lives.

programme.title: Voices for Humanity
programme.desc: Jorjão Oliveira had a promising rap music career in Brazil before drugs and subsequent time in prison cut it short; with a new goal to prevent kids from destroying their lives with drugs, he started a popular rap group spreading an antidrug message.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
programme.desc: Stacy Sass reluctantly steps in to save her family business making steel for infrastructure projects across the United States; invoking the mantra that steel is only as strong as those who fabricate it, she helps the company and its employees thrive.

programme.title: Dianetics: An Introduction
programme.desc: L. Ron Hubbard's all-time bestselling book on the human mind, "Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health," inspired a movement spanning every continent on earth. Find out how painful experiences of your past can affect you in the present day.

programme.title: Destination Scientology

programme.title: I Am a Scientologist

programme.title: Voices for Humanity
